data.one_liner: Translate text and use TTS via SimplyTranslate, Lingva Translate, and LibreTranslate.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart interface to translate text using alternative translation frontends like SimplyTranslate, Lingva Translate, and LibreTranslate. It also supports text-to-speech (TTS) and instance management.
use_when: You want to translate text using open-source alternatives to Google Translate.
You need text-to-speech (TTS) capabilities in your application.
avoid_when: You require an official Google Translate API with guaranteed uptime and SLAs.
You cannot configure or supply a custom remote URL for working instances.
strengths: Supports multiple open-source translation engines (SimplyTranslate, Lingva, LibreTranslate).
Allows fetching and testing working instances.
weaknesses: Public instances are removed due to misuse, requiring you to set a custom remote URL.
Instance availability depends on third-party volunteers and can change at any time.
